faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the WAMUL NEDFL Assistant – Warehouse & Logistics recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the WAMUL NEDFL Assistant – Warehouse & Logistics recruitment is 11 August 2026. Ensure your application is submitted before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have completed a full-time Graduation from a recognized Institute/University to be eligible for the Assistant – Warehouse & Logistics position.

faq.question: Q3. How many years of experience are needed for the Assistant – Warehouse & Logistics role?
faq.answer: A minimum of 2 years of relevant experience in Warehousing or Logistics is required for this position.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the WAMUL NEDFL Assistant – Warehouse & Logistics recruitment?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applicants is 28 years. Age relaxation may be provided for exceptional candidates.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Assistant – Warehouse & Logistics post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a salary of Rs. 4.55 lakhs Per Annum (CTC).

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the WAMUL NEDFL Assistant – Warehouse & Logistics recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process includes Document Verification, a Written Test, and a Personal Interview.

faq.question: Q8. What is the application mode for this job?
faq.answer: Applications for the WAMUL NEDFL Assistant – Warehouse & Logistics recruitment must be submitted online.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for this position?
faq.answer: The job location is Guwahati, Assam, with a pincode of 781037.
